items.title: iPad
items.line: Announced 27 January and on sale 3 April 2010 from $499, with a 9.7-inch screen. About 300,000 sold on day one and 3 million in 80 days.

items.title: Instagram
items.line: Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger put it on the App Store on 6 October 2010, iPhone only. It had a million registered users in about two months.

items.title: Inception
items.line: Opened 16 July 2010. Nolan shot the zero-gravity hallway fight in a real corridor set built on rotating rings. Four Oscars, about $839 million.

items.title: 2010 FIFA World Cup
items.line: The first finals in Africa, in South Africa, 11 June to 11 July 2010. Spain beat the Netherlands 1-0 after extra time for their first title.

items.title: Chilean miners rescued
items.line: 33 men were trapped about 700 m down from 5 August. The last came up on 13 October 2010, day 69, in the Fenix capsule, with about 5.3 million watching online.

items.title: Toy Story 3
items.line: Out 18 June 2010, directed by Lee Unkrich. On 27 August, its 71st day in theaters, it became the first animated film past $1 billion, and it won two Oscars.

items.title: Pumped Up Kicks goes viral
items.line: Mark Foster posted it as a free download in early 2010 and blogs spread it. SXSW followed in March, and the band signed to a Columbia imprint in May.
